requirement: Validate an update-antibiotic-group command: the group ID, name, and description must not be empty or whitespace, and the parent ID must be either null or a non-empty GUID.

preconditions.text: Validation runs on an in-memory command without database access

inputs.text: Valid root-group update for 'Beta-lactams' with a null parent
Valid root-group update for 'Macrolides' with a null parent
Valid subgroup update with a version-7 parent ID
Empty name and a valid description
Whitespace-only name and a valid description
Valid name and an empty description
Valid name and a whitespace-only description
Empty ID, empty name, and empty description

returns.text: Single validation error reported on Name or Description
Single validation error reported on Id
Single validation error reported on ParentId
Three violations reported for three invalid fields

exception_text: No unhandled exception; invalid input is reported as validation errors
